item.title: Sukumizu 2 ~Oyo-ge-na-i~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Circus Fetish
  • 発売日: 2005-08-26
  • スコア: 6.39/10 (10 人評価)
  • 日本語名: すくみず２～泳・げ・な・い～
  • 英語名: Sukumizu 2 Oyo-ge-na-i

别名

  • Sukumizu 2 I Can‛＼t Swim

あらすじ

Just like it’s prequel, the game is released under the Circus brand division ‘Circus Fetish’ and focuses on school swimsuits.

The protagonist, an excellent competitive swimmer, returns to his sea-side hometown after several years of absence to be a teacher.

Naturally he meets several girls, and begins teaching them how to swim…

item.title: Sukumizu ~Fetish☆ ni Narumon!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Circus Fetish
  • 発売日: 2003-07-25
  • スコア: 6.55/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: すくみず～フェチ☆になるもんっ！～
  • 英語名: Sukumizu Fetish☆ ni Narumon!

别名

  • Sukumizu Fecchi☆ ni Narumon!

あらすじ

Released under the Circus brand division ‘Circus Fetish’, this game focuses on school swimsuits.

The protagonist, Shimano Kanata, is a well-known swimmer in the prefecture with a fetish for water in general, and women’s swim-wear in particular.

Somehow he ends up in a private girls school in a well-known beautiful mountain region. There he meets the various girls from the swimming club and the story unfolds…
